questions.stem: An object has a density of 0.8 g/cm cubed and is placed in water (density 1.0 g/cm cubed). What will happen?

options.text: The object will sink to the bottom

questions.explanation: An object floats if its density is less than the density of the liquid it is placed in. Since 0.8 g/cm cubed is less than 1.0 g/cm cubed (water), the object will float.

questions.stem: To find the volume of an irregularly shaped object for a density measurement, you should use:

options.text: A ruler to measure its length, width, and height
A displacement method with a measuring cylinder or eureka can

questions.explanation: For irregularly shaped objects, the displacement method is used. The object is submerged in water in a measuring cylinder or eureka can, and the volume of water displaced equals the volume of the object.
